episodes.title: Lost
episodes.summary: Cat gang leader Gus and his crew of feral felines go on a hunting trip to the cemetery to catch some tasty mice. But instead, they find a lost kitten.

episodes.title: Havoc
episodes.summary: Riots on the news inspire the gang to cause havoc and attack an unsuspecting human. A trip to the vet for a friend and fellow cat dampens their spirits.

episodes.title: Kids
episodes.summary: Relationship chat derails the plan to find the kitten's home. Puke lets a surprising secret out of the bag, which prompts Gus to visit his ailing mother.

episodes.title: Date Night
episodes.summary: The gang takes on an impossible challenge to get Puke adopted. Gus is torn between playing it cool and asking a feisty feline out on a date.

episodes.title: Mum
episodes.summary: Bedridden with a feline flu, the kitten has a fever dream that reveals a clue to finding home. Gus gets his paws on some catnip to deal with bad news.

episodes.title: Home
episodes.summary: The gang plans to retrace the steps of the fever dream, but talk of pesky bees sends them on a side mission. Will the kitten ever find the way home?
